tasks.label: Rodar Menu Visitante
tasks.command: chcp 65001 | Out-Null; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force out | Out-Null; javac -encoding UTF-8 -d out -sourcepath src src/Visao/App.java; if ($?) { java '-Dfile.encoding=UTF-8' '-Dstdout.encoding=UTF-8' '-Dstdin.encoding=UTF-8' -cp out Visao.App }
